roadmap.title: Complete the opening and starter tasks
roadmap.description: Play the prologue, establish the Northtown operation, recruit Benji, and finish the quick arrest, pickpocket, skateboard, and $100-product achievements.

roadmap.title: Build the operation while clearing counters
roadmap.description: Scale toward $100,000 while depositing street trash and banking spray cans for a single uninterrupted 25-tag route.

roadmap.title: Defeat the Benzies cartel
roadmap.description: Stay hostile, lower influence to open every region, unlock Uptown, complete Finishing the Job, and continue scaling toward $1 million.

roadmap.title: Finish the wealth grind
roadmap.description: Keep the established endgame production and dealer network operating until the displayed net worth reaches $10 million.

achievements.summary: Play the full opening @mechanic{prologue} to its conclusion without using Skip Prologue.

guide.context: Skipping the prologue starts the main game but bypasses this opening completion flag, so use a fresh save if the sequence was skipped.

steps.text: Start a new game and choose to play the @mechanic{prologue}.
Follow every prologue objective until the opening sequence ends and Hyland Point becomes available.

achievements.summary: Follow the early main quest after the prologue, return to the exploded @loc{RV}, and read the note left there.

guide.context: This automatic setback is part of the first main-quest chain and remains available whether the prologue was played or skipped.

steps.text: Continue the first main objectives in Hyland Point until an explosion is heard.
Return to the @loc{RV} after the explosion and approach the wreckage.
Interact with the note at the destroyed @loc{RV} to finish the setback sequence.

achievements.summary: Unlock @npc{Benji Coleman} by satisfying one of the first three contacts, then pay his $500 cash signing fee in @loc{Motel Room 2}.

guide.context: Benji is the first regional dealer and covers Northtown, so recruit him before expanding the operation into later districts.

steps.text: Complete orders for the starting customers until one of the first three contacts becomes satisfied and @npc{Benji Coleman} unlocks.
Carry $500 cash to the @loc{Motel} and enter @loc{Room 2}.
Speak with @npc{Benji Coleman} and pay the signing fee to recruit him as the first dealer.

achievements.description: Manufacture a product worth at least $100.
achievements.summary: Remove a mixed product worth at least $100 from a @item{Mixing Station}; first-level meth precursor mixed with @item{Addy} is a confirmed recipe.

guide.context: The reliable early route opens after the story mission @mechanic{We Need to Cook}; Addy appears at the Westville corner store after sufficient rank progression.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{We Need to Cook} and continue ranking up until @item{Addy} is stocked at the @loc{Westville corner store}.
Place first-level @item{meth precursor} and @item{Addy} into a @item{Mixing Station}, then run the mixing process.
Confirm that the finished product is valued at $100 or more, then remove it from the @item{Mixing Station}.

achievements.summary: Raise the save file's displayed net worth to $100,000, then sleep in a bed to end the day and trigger the check.

guide.context: The current net-worth total is visible on the save-file screen, while the achievement is evaluated when a day is ended by sleeping.

steps.text: Expand production and sales while retaining enough value for the save-file screen to show at least $100,000 net worth.
Sleep in a bed to end the day and let the achievement check the qualifying net worth.

achievements.summary: Raise the save file's displayed net worth to $1,000,000, then sleep in a bed to trigger the end-of-day check.

guide.context: This is the middle of the three net-worth milestones; the final achievement uses the same displayed total with a $10 million target.

steps.text: Reinvest sales into larger production capacity and dealer coverage until the save-file screen shows at least $1,000,000 net worth.
Sleep in a bed to end the day and trigger the qualifying net-worth check.

achievements.summary: Raise the save file's displayed net worth to $10,000,000, then sleep in a bed to trigger the final wealth check.

guide.context: This is the dominant completion-time grind, far beyond the earlier $100,000 and $1 million net-worth milestones.

steps.text: Keep the endgame production chain supplied and the dealer network selling until the save-file screen shows at least $10,000,000 net worth.
Sleep in a bed to end the day and register the final net-worth milestone.

achievements.description: Dispose of 500 pieces of trash at the Cash for Trash machines.
achievements.summary: Collect and deposit 500 pieces of street trash in @mechanic{Cash for Trash machines}. Use @item{Trash Grabbers} from a hardware store.

guide.context: Trash Grabbers cost $20 at hardware stores and can collect the scattered cigarettes, newspapers, bottles, cans, leaves, syringes, and other litter that feeds the cumulative machine counter.

steps.text: Buy several @item{Trash Grabbers} for $20 each from a @loc{hardware store}.
Equip a @item{Trash Grabber} and collect every piece of loose litter along the streets and around buildings.
Take the collected litter to a @mechanic{Cash for Trash machine} and deposit every piece.
Repeat the collection and deposit route until the machine counter has accepted 500 pieces of trash.

achievements.summary: Pay @npc{Jeff} $1,500 cash for the @item{Golden Skateboard} at @loc{Shred's Shack} between 6:00 AM and 6:00 PM.

guide.context: Shred's Shack accepts cash and is open from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM; arriving outside that window prevents the purchase.

steps.text: Carry $1,500 cash and visit @loc{Shred's Shack} between 6:00 AM and 6:00 PM.
Speak with @npc{Jeff} and purchase the @item{Golden Skateboard}.

achievements.displayName: The Long Arm of the Law
achievements.summary: Violate curfew while carrying illegal product, remain near the responding police, and allow the officers to complete an arrest.

guide.context: Curfew violations, fleeing an attempted search, carrying drugs during a search, assault, and witnessed theft can all start the required police response.

steps.text: Carry illegal product after curfew or commit another offense in view of a police officer.
Do not escape the responding officers; remain in their reach until the arrest sequence completes.

achievements.description: Sell something to a customer, then pickpocket it back.
achievements.summary: Complete a customer order, crouch behind that same customer, and win the pickpocket minigame to steal back the product just sold.

guide.context: The target must first receive product through a completed order arranged in the phone app; stealing unrelated inventory does not satisfy the sell-and-recover sequence.

steps.text: Accept a customer's order in the phone app and deliver the requested product to complete the sale.
Follow the same customer, crouch directly behind them, and use the pickpocket interaction.
Complete the pickpocket minigame and take back the product that was delivered in the preceding sale.

achievements.description: Graffiti 25 surfaces in a single save.
achievements.summary: On the public branch, paint 25 distinct graffiti zones in one save; the safest route completes all 25 in one uninterrupted in-game day.

guide.context: This counter can fail on beta builds or older overwritten saves. Gas Marts add one spray can to stock per level gained, and equipping a can reveals valid white tagging zones around the map.

steps.text: Switch Steam to the normal public branch, load the intended save, and stockpile 25 spray cans from @loc{Gas Mart} locations before starting the route.
Equip a @item{spray can} to reveal the white graffiti zones, then plan a route through 25 distinct surfaces.
Paint all 25 distinct graffiti zones during one uninterrupted in-game day without sleeping or reloading.

If the achievement still does not register, use 25 @item{Graffiti Removers} to clean 25 tagged zones and repaint all 25 in the same day; retry that uninterrupted route on a fresh public-branch save if the old save continues to undercount.

achievements.description: Defeat the Benzies Family in Hyland Point.
achievements.summary: Reject @npc{Thomas Benzies}' truce, unlock @loc{Uptown}, and finish the cartel story by detonating a bomb beneath @loc{Hyland Manor}.

guide.context: The hostile route permits progression through every region. After Uptown is unlocked and a night passes, Uncle Nelson starts the finale; prepare $10,000 and 20 grams of packaged unmixed cocaine, and be ready to fight an armed thief.

steps.text: Reject @npc{Thomas Benzies}' truce at the @loc{Taco Ticklers parking lot}, lower cartel influence below 300 in each blocked region, and continue until @loc{Uptown} unlocks.
Sleep after unlocking @loc{Uptown}, then answer @npc{Uncle Nelson}'s payphone call to begin @mechanic{Finishing the Job}.
Meet @npc{Sam} at @loc{Thompson Construction & Demo} and pay $10,000 to have a tunnel dug beneath @loc{Hyland Manor}.
Meet @npc{Billy} at the @loc{Chemical Plant} and trade 20 grams of packaged, unmixed cocaine for @item{RDX}.
Take the @item{RDX} to @npc{Stan} at the @loc{Illegal Warehouse}, find the armed thief at the @loc{Docks} at night, eliminate him, and return to Stan for the finished bomb.

Sleep until @npc{Sam} texts that the map-marked tunnel is ready, enter the tunnel, plant the bomb under @loc{Hyland Manor}, and wait clear of the 45-second countdown until the Benzies Family defeat sequence finishes.
